案例英文摘要；原始代码、日志与案例摘录保留原文。: English case summaries are shown below. Source code, logs and original case excerpts remain unchanged.

_caseSummaries.CASE_RANK_SWITCH: After changing configuration, verify that the new scorer is actually invoked at runtime.
_caseSummaries.CASE_RANK_FALLBACK: Keep LegacyRanker callable and preserve its original ranking behavior as a fallback.
_caseSummaries.CASE_RANK_SCHEMA: Add an adapter to preserve the public score and metadata contract when scorer output schemas differ.
_caseSummaries.CASE_RANK_EMPTY: Handle empty candidate input explicitly and preserve an empty ranking result.
_caseSummaries.CASE_RANK_TIES: Preserve deterministic ordering when candidates receive equal scores.
_caseSummaries.CASE_EMBED_DIM: Check query and index dimensions; rebuild the index after changing embedding dimensions.
_caseSummaries.CASE_EMBED_MODEL: Different embedding checkpoints can use different vector spaces even at the same dimension. Verify model identity and rebuild.
_caseSummaries.CASE_EMBED_NORM: Normalize document and query vectors consistently when using inner product for cosine similarity.
_caseSummaries.CASE_EMBED_BATCH: Encode in bounded batches so memory use depends on batch size rather than total corpus size.
_caseSummaries.CASE_INDEX_FILTER: Apply metadata eligibility filtering before final Top-K selection.
_caseSummaries.CASE_INDEX_DIVERSITY: Limit chunks per case so one historical case does not occupy all context slots.
_caseSummaries.CASE_QUERY_ERROR: Include actual validation or execution failures in the next retrieval query and planning context.
_caseSummaries.CASE_PLAN_JSON: Parse and validate a JSON object and its action list before execution.
_caseSummaries.CASE_EXEC_PATH: Reject traversal, absolute paths and non-allowlisted edits; validate the full action batch before writing.
_caseSummaries.CASE_EXEC_CHECKPOINT: Restore original file bytes, remove newly created files and explicitly report restoration failures.
_caseSummaries.CASE_EXEC_BYTECODE: Avoid stale Python bytecode affecting rapid edit-and-test cycles.
_caseSummaries.CASE_EXEC_TIMEOUT: Apply a timeout to fixed validation subprocesses and record timeout failures.
_caseSummaries.CASE_DEPENDENCY_ABI: Use compatible NumPy and FAISS builds; smoke-test imports or explicitly select the NumPy index fallback.
_caseSummaries.CASE_CONFIG_RELOAD: Ensure the runtime reads the active configuration rather than stale cached settings.
_caseSummaries.CASE_CACHE_STALE: Rebuild or invalidate retrieval indexes when the underlying case content changes.

新评分器输出的解释信息消失了，消费者解析失败，怎样兼容旧协议？: The new scorer lost explanation fields and downstream parsing fails. How can the old contract be preserved?
配置已经切换了，但结果看起来还是上一版模型，怎么证明新实现生效？: Configuration changed, but results look unchanged. How can actual new-algorithm activation be verified?
新排序组件上线以后出了问题，我想快速退回旧路径并确认结果没变。: The new ranking component has a problem. How can I return to the old path and verify its behavior?
没有任何候选时，新的打分模块直接崩溃，该在哪里处理边界？: The new scorer crashes when there are no candidates. Where should this boundary be handled?
同样的数据重复请求，得分相同的条目顺序漂移，翻页还会漏数据。: Equal-score items change order between identical requests, causing pagination gaps.
检索编码器换过版本，向量长度没变却找不到相关历史经验了。: The encoder version changed. Vector length is unchanged, but relevant experience is no longer retrieved.
相似度总偏爱模长大的文档，两边的表示应该如何处理？: Similarity favors large-magnitude document vectors. How should both representations be handled?
历史经验越来越多，一次索引就把显卡撑爆，如何让内存消耗有上界？: Encoding all historical cases at once exhausts GPU memory. How can memory use stay bounded?
明明有同模块的历史记录，加上筛选条件后反而一条也找不到。: Matching same-module cases disappear when a module filter is added.
检索到的五条经验其实是同一件事的不同片段，怎么增加上下文覆盖？: All five retrieved chunks describe one case. How can context coverage be increased?
代理计划里夹杂了不允许修改的文件，前面的合法动作能先执行吗？: A plan contains forbidden edits. Can its earlier valid actions be applied first?
重试全部耗尽后，如何确认恢复的是最初状态，而不是某次中间修改？: After retries run out, how can restoration to the original state be verified?
代码明明已经改了，测试却像在跑旧版本，连续快速修改时才出现。: Tests seem to run old code after rapid consecutive edits.
知识库内容更新过，但召回的还是旧方案，要检查什么缓存标识？: Knowledge content changed, but retrieval returns old solutions. Which cache identity should be checked?
失败后一直重试同一方案，怎么让检索利用缺失字段和测试报错？: Retries repeat the same approach. How can retrieval use missing fields and test failures?
模型计划不是合法对象，解析失败后如何记录并带着错误再次规划？: The model plan is not a valid object. How should parsing failure be recorded and used on retry?
